name: dumbbell standing one arm concentration curl
description: Standing and leaning forward, you curl one dumbbell with your elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps one side at a time.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend forward at the hips until your torso is nearly level with the floor, free hand on your thigh.
Let the working arm hang straight down.
Keep your upper arm still and curl the dumbbell toward your face.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
